# 05.1 Find and Fix HTML Mistakes

`app.html` is a small page riddled with the common anti-patterns and errors you have just studied. Clean it up into accessible, valid, maintainable HTML.

**Your task:** rewrite `app.html` so it follows HTML best practices, keeping the page's content and purpose intact.

- Remove the stacked `<br>` tags used only for spacing.
- Give every `<img>` descriptive `alt` text.
- Fix the heading hierarchy so levels go in order with no skipped levels.
- Replace generic `<div>` containers with the appropriate semantic elements where one fits.
- Apply consistent indentation throughout, and make sure all tags are properly closed and nested.

**Expected result:** the page renders the same content but its markup is clean and valid — semantic elements in place of generic divs, every image with alt text, a logical heading order, and no `<br>` tags used for layout.
